descricao_original: As germinal centers enlarge within in the PALS, they displace the central arteriole to a more eccentric position, as seen here. Surrounding the lymphoid nodule is red pulp in which the splenic sinuses are completely filled with blood, obscuring the lumens. The junction of the white pulp with red pulp is referred to as the marginal zone, and sinuses located in this region are termed marginal sinuses. 200x
